set.body:
Goal: make modules/dataset the rock-solid typed access surface for multi-subject, multi-session, and multi-run fMRI datasets. This should be idiomatic Scala 3 rather than an R/S3-shaped port: invalid dataset states should be hard or impossible to construct, storage adapters should stay behind typed contracts, and fitting/MVPA consumers should receive inspectable dataset views instead of stringly row/metadata bundles.

Scope: active voxel-domain semantics, typed DatasetKey/RunKey hierarchy, dataset-owned time/run axes, typed events/metadata, LNA/BIDS adapter boundaries, parsed entity queries, and JVM+Scala.js regression coverage.

Acceptance: the default dataset read contract is unambiguous for full-volume and masked/latent backends; multi-subject/session/run datasets are represented by typed keys and validated axes; event rows and metadata are no longer raw Map[String,String] at core boundaries; LNA lookup uses parsed entities rather than filename substring matching; the module boundary with bids is either repaired with a narrow adapter or intentionally redocumented; datasetJVM/test and datasetJS/test pass, with end-to-end multi-run fixtures.
set.title: EPIC: Dataset architecture hardening for multi-run fMRI
